Name: Cuter Catfish
Author: AvatarKitten
Description:
Do you love cats? Do you love fishing? This mod is here for you!

This mod adds in 7 new fish, all different types of cats. There's 4 common catfish: the calico catfish , black catfish, orange catfish, and ragdoll catfish. Alongside those, there's 3 special catfish: the nyan catfish, the desert catfish, and the lucky catfish. These fish are all able to be added to fish ponds and aquariums, and all 7 have items they produce in fish ponds besides roe. 

[b]THIS MOD REQUIRES [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CONTENT PATCHER

[/url]Spoilers below for fish locations, seasons, and times, and fish pond produce~

[spoiler]

All fish can be caught in any weather, from 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM.

The Calico Catfish can be caught in spring, in the Cindersap Forest pond.﻿

The Orange Catfish can be caught in summer, in the Cindersap Forest pond.

The Black Catfish can be caught in fall, in the Cindersap Forest pond.

The Ragdoll Catfish can be caught in winter, in the Cindersap Forest pond.

The Nyan Catfish can be caught in any season, in the Secret Woods.

The Desert Catfish can be caught in any season, in Calico Desert.

The Lucky Catfish can be caught in any season, in the oceans of Ginger Island.


The Calico, Orange, Black, and Ragdoll Catfish all have a chance to produce wool, duck feathers, and rabbit's feet in their fish ponds (10% chance for wool and duck feathers, 5% chance for rabbit's foot).

The Nyan Catfish has a chance to produce a prismatic shard in its fish pond (1% chance).

The Desert Catfish has a chance to produce artifact troves in its fish pond (5% chance, will give 3-5).

The Lucky Catfish has a chance to produce a treasure chest in its fish pond (1% chance).

[/spoiler]
